Edinburgh Global Online Learning Masters Scholarship 2024 is an opportunity offered by the University of Edinburgh

to students applying for the distance master's program offered by the university. A total of 12 students will receive full tuition fee coverage till the completion of an online distance learning master’s program in session 2024-25.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
hold an offer to pursue a distance learning master's program at the University of Edinburgh
A total of 12 selected candidates will receive a full tuition fee waiver for the duration of their distance learning master's program.

Once the application is accepted by the University, they will send a confirmation email. The following steps to apply for the scholarship will be communicated accordingly.
It might take five business days for the University to confirm the submission of the applicant and send a confirmation email to the registered email address.
Scholarship selection considers both academic merit and the strength of applicants' personal statements. Priority will be given to students who have not previously studied at the master's level.
Applicants must first apply for admission to the University of Edinburgh to be eligible for the scholarship application system.
The application process for admission can take up to five working days to complete system checks and grant access.
Once applicants receive their University of Edinburgh Username (UUN) and EASE passwords, they can apply for scholarships.
The scholarship is only available to students who have been admitted to an eligible online part-time Master's program, not those who have already started their program.
